item.tib: g.yag ru dgra chos kyi bca' ka'i yig chung dang shug mgon rnams la gsol kha 'bul ba
item.coloph: ces pas shug mgon rnams kyi bca' ka'i yig chung dang gsol kha 'bul ba sbad pa bcas dbyil ston khyung rgod rtsal gyis zang zang lha brag gi pha bong stag 'dra ba'i bswe sgrom nang nas zab gter spyan drangs pa'o//
